'''Docking Bay 3''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="legacy38" />

In [[137 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] and his crew docked their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] on Docking Bay 3 while searching for replacement parts.<ref name="legacy38" />
